scope: ACP v1 session and approval identity across a real stdio reconnect

before.observation: Two actual ACP processes issued the same session and approval IDs. A stale prompt sent to the second process reached the model. A stale allow from the first process applied to a different Tool Call in the second process and the authorized file Provider wrote a fixture file. Both added Rust assertions failed on this executable.

after.observation: A stale session ID receives invalid params before a model call. A stale approval response does not match the new request. The current explicit denial settles through the existing Provider and the fixture file stays absent. A valid current prompt proceeds.

preservedLinuxFailure.observation: The first container run had no init. Both new reconnect cases passed. The existing stdout-disconnect case still saw the Shell process group after the CLI exited, yielding 14 passed and 1 failed. The same source and assertions passed with Docker init. The first group's individual process states were not captured.

limits: Synthetic profile, loopback model and test file only. The macOS artifact uses the standard archive layout; no install or default entry change was performed.
The protocol change does not introduce session/load or treat a transport ID as a stored conversation identity. Actual editor verification, the legacy installed handoff and the P4 gate remain open.
